description: This file defines a PHP class `HTMLPurifier_StringHashParser` responsible for parsing string hash configuration files, including single and multi string-hash files delimited by '----'. It contains methods for parsing files and file handles, and manages internal parsing state. It primarily facilitates reading configuration schemas stored in a specific text format.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_StringHashParser
classes.description: A parser for string hash configuration files, capable of handling both single and multi-hash formats with inline and multiline values.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses a file containing a single string-hash and returns an associative array of key-value pairs.

methods.name: parseMultiFile
methods.description: Parses a file containing multiple string-hash sections delimited by '----'.

methods.name: parseHandle
methods.description: Internal method that parses a file handle to extract the string-hash data into an associative array.
